05 / A LITTLE CLARITY

Your questions.
Thoughtfully answered.

Something else on your mind?

Let’s talk on WhatsApp ↗
How does our wedding website work?+

You receive a personalised link with your wedding story, schedule, venue and guest information. Share it through WhatsApp, Instagram or a QR code on printed invitations.

How do we submit our wedding details?+

Start with an enquiry. We’ll confirm your package and send a checklist for your names, photos, love story, dates, venues and design preferences.

Do guests need to download an app?+

No. Guests open your link in their phone or computer browser.

How are RSVP responses collected?+

The Showcase is a static wedding website without RSVP. The Guest Manager prepares RSVP responses for the couple’s WhatsApp; guests tap Send to deliver them. The Command Centre also records responses in the private couple dashboard and supports a privately connected Google Sheet.

How do we receive monetary gifts?+

Guests see the bank details you choose to display and transfer directly to your account. Please double-check your details before sharing your website.

Does Safiyah’s Gleam handle payments or wedding gifts?+

No. We do not collect or hold guest gift funds. Transfers happen directly between the guest and the couple’s bank.

How does the private dashboard work?+

Sign in with ChatGPT to create and access your wedding records. Every request checks ownership on the server. You can add invited guests, share their personal RSVP links and manually record gifts received.

How long will our website remain active?+

Your hosting period and any renewal costs will be agreed in writing before you book. Please tell us how long you would like to keep your wedding website.

Can we have a custom domain?+

Yes. Custom domains start from ₦15,000. Availability, registration and renewal costs are confirmed before purchase.

How do we get started?+

Choose your experience and send an enquiry. We’ll discuss your celebration, confirm the scope and timeline, then guide you through booking.
